mainEntity.name: What types of materials are used in exterior restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exterior restoration utilizes a diverse range of materials, chosen to match the original construction or to provide enhanced durability and performance. Common materials include various types of stucco, brick, natural stone, wood, concrete, and metals. Mortars, sealants, paints, and protective coatings are also integral. For historical properties, special attention is given to sourcing historically accurate or compatible materials to maintain authenticity. The choice of material is always guided by the building's age, architectural style, and functional requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Materials include stucco, brick, stone, wood, concrete, metals, mortars, and paints, often selected to match original construction or for improved durability, especially for historic properties.
